- `docs/n-link-speed-up.md` describes the MCDMA N-link settings for speed-up mode, including rank/peer configuration, Thunderbolt RDMA devices, ports, and GIDs for tensor and expert parallelism across multiple Macs.
- `docs/recipes/adding-a-zig-family.md` covers tensor and expert parallel over MCDMA with exchanges inside the command buffer, experts

`fabric-check --gids DEVICE` probes each Thunderbolt RDMA device to establish that it exposes ACTIVE ports and usable GIDs before qualification. It verifies the N-link fabric setup so that the corresponding cable ends and meeting interfaces can be correctly paired across ranks.
We identified files covering tensor parallelism, then named and described the `fabric-check --gids DEVICE` function from `docs/n-link-speed-up.md`.
